text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The race I've always dreamed of...! The 
very first GⅠ where my absolute faves, 
Opera O-san and Doto-san, stand 
side-by-side...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I know full well that little loli Digitan 
in her Classic Year doesn't stand a 
chance! Even so! No matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wanna watch from the very front row!!

Succumbing to Agnes Digital's flying 
dogeza, we decided to take on the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is the reality of it. B-B-But 
through Digi-tan's eyes...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you all this time! 
Come, dive right into my arms, Dotooou♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... Even knowing this is a sacred 
match, those old delusions of mine are 
charging in like a tractor...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Just now, just for now, please! In 
return, I promise I'll run with everything 
I've got in the race!"

Let's see how much Agnes Digital's running 
can add to the brilliance of those two.
